scenario: Build two interview-loop options for a candidate in Berlin with four Seattle interviewers and a decision deadline next Friday.

messages.text: Build two interview-loop options for a candidate in Berlin with four Seattle interviewers and a decision deadline next Friday.
I identified the recruiting decision, the evidence needed, and the boundary that must stay human-owned.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.
I produced outputs/recruiting-coordinator-handoff.md, with facts, assumptions, open questions, and the next accountable owner separated.

report.title: Recruiting coordinator session handoff
report.summary: Timezone-safe schedule options with breaks and competency coverage, conflict flags, a candidate draft awaiting approval, and a feedback-completion tracker without candidate ranking.

items.title: Interview plan
items.summary: The proposed loop covers required competencies, constraints, timezones, breaks, and accessibility needs

items.title: Communication draft
items.summary: Candidate-facing text is clearly marked draft until the recruiting owner approves it

items.title: Feedback tracker
items.summary: Do not request diagnosis or medical details, infer protected characteristics, rank candidates, or shape hiring evaluation; keep requested scheduling accommodations separate from interviewer feedback

items.title: Process handoff
items.summary: The final answer names the accountable next owner and preserves the reusable artifact path.
